claim_summary: TIEM contributes timestamp-gated event-evidence retrieval, outcome-informed forecast skill memory, joint evidence-experience fusion, an optional skill-conditioned forecasting procedure, and a name-date contamination probe for financial return-direction forecasting.

notes: The blind record grouped availability checks with EEH/CSM. Reconciliation retains the card's separately reusable ancestry-gate ID and assigns validation to that module; EEH remains the temporal index/retrieval contribution. The old catalyst memory ID is retained for CSM, with optional SCMR separated. Forecasting predicts three- or five-trading-day numerical return direction; no trading action or utility is evaluated. The reported workflow has frozen read-only CSM and one HEFR call, so fixed_workflow describes evaluated operation despite training-time outcome-feedback memory acquisition. Optional stability diagnosis, reweighting, and SCMR have no reported effectiveness evaluation. FinPURE is excluded under R1 as an evaluation dataset of a method paper; the separately designed NDP procedure is included. Multiple markets, periods, and backbones demonstrate one task family only. The temporal audit is temporal-validity evidence, without a separate runtime execution-validity evaluation.
